title: From Deep Learning to LLMs: A survey of AI in Quantitative Investment

task.value: A survey of how deep learning and LLMs contribute to the quantitative investment (alpha strategy) pipeline, from data processing to order execution.
task.quote: In this survey, taking alpha strategy as a representative example, we explore how AI contributes to the quantitative investment pipeline.

limitations.value: Authors identify field limitations: LLM agents' weak numerical reasoning, underdeveloped portfolio optimization, neglect of transaction costs and perfect-liquidity assumptions, and latency in real-time decisions.
limitations.quote: This limitation is exacerbated by the widespread neglect of transaction cost modeling, with most systems assuming frictionless markets.
